API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPartner IntegrationsGenerate External Id
Generate External Id
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/publicCloudInfo/generateExternalId

Creates an external ID for an AWS account.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
awsAccountId
string

The ID of the AWS account where workloads are deployed. The ID is non-null, non-empty, and unique, and contains 12 digits.

awsRoleName
string

The AWS trusting role in your account. The name is non-null, non-empty, unique, and 64 characters or fewer in length.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
string
string

Returns the External ID of the AWS account.
